{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique values in the 'arm' column
print('Unique arms:', df['arm'].unique())

# Check unique values in the 'responded' column
print('Unique responded values:', df['responded'].unique())

# Filter for the TREATMENT arm
treatment_df = df[df['arm'] == 'TREATMENT']

# Check how many patients are in the TREATMENT arm
print(f'Treatment arm size: {len(treatment_df)}')

# Check how many responded in the TREATMENT arm
responded_count = treatment_df['responded'].sum()
print(f'Responded count in TREATMENT arm: {responded_count}')

# Calculate the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = responded_count / len(treatment_df)
print(f'Fraction responded in TREATMENT arm: {fraction_responded}')"}
